baseline.runner_compatibility: Only the additive optional decision_at_s keyword is authorized. Default assessment, numerical kernel, original reader, reference policy and manifest must remain bound to the stored baseline.

gain_boundary.selection: For each selected door model, minimum_gain is exactly the maximum stored score_gain among its numerically evaluable, original-band-admissible and geometry-supported calibration counter endpoints. Apply only when every R03 positive endpoint is frontier-eligible and this maximum is strictly below their minimum gain. No epsilon, iterative search or R04 choice.
gain_boundary.infusion: No eligible calibration counter exists; retain the exact original profile and minimum_gain. This is not a learned infusion separation level.
gain_boundary.invariants: Only policy.minimum_gain and the consequent raw score.status may differ. Forms, bands, D, B/V/noise/A, raw template/null losses, gain, original support and geometry owners remain unchanged. Higher gain thresholds must yield a subset of baseline-supported onsets; clustered claim counts need not be monotone.
gain_boundary.scope: Only baseline plus this one fixed gain hypothesis. Re-run earliest confirmation through the unchanged horizon on the existing R03/R04 scope and all existing decision traces. Do not repeat the five cause variants or any profile refit.

scope.trace_schedule: Every original confirmation-grid decision through the unchanged profile horizon, even after an earlier support; actual decision_at_s is explicit.
scope.R01_R02: Only manifest/fixture hashes and stored method records are consumed; no original re-fit or replay scan.

factor_invariants.band_ablations: Exactly identical full frozen binding and raw numerical continuation score at common decision times. Only declared residual-band booleans and derived support status may differ; all geometry gates execute through the existing assessment owner.
factor_invariants.form_refit: R03 user-confirmed door flank examples only; original selected basis, knot, D, onsets, numerical policy, noise floors and prefix unchanged. B/V/noise and original support remain equal. A is re-estimated once on that same prefix as a necessary consequence of the changed shape.
factor_invariants.infusion: Reuse the exact baseline profile in every variant, except the two explicitly declared band-veto ablations. No infusion refit.

method_overlap.source: Stored calibration.json positive_assessments and known_counterexample_assessments only
method_overlap.frontier: For retained numerically evaluable, band-admissible and geometry-supported endpoints, gain > threshold retains positives and rejects counters when max(counter_gain) <= threshold < min(positive_gain). Unknown geometry is never negative evidence.
method_overlap.limitation: Stored assessments stop at their first support. These endpoint intervals do not simulate later confirmations under a changed threshold and do not establish a new recognition rate. R04 is excluded from all threshold/method selection.

interpretation: A fixed factor diagnosis, not threshold tuning, detector integration, product activation, independent validation or P(event). R03-only training is resubstitution on the same R03 inventory. R04 was previously inspected.
